name: Aperture Dating Simulator
source:
After a missing employee leaves a maintenance position vacant, Aperture swoops you out of manufacturing to take his place. Will you stay true to your contract, or fall for your subordinates?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3723280/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一名失踪员工留下了一个维护职位空缺后，Aperture将你从制造业中调出以取代他的位置。你会遵守合同，还是会爱上你的下属？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3723280/]Steam[/url]]
